build_Sam3TrackerBase: build a Sam3TrackerBase video object tracking model with backbone, transformer, and memory encoder components
create_forward_tracking: create forward video tracking on each frame processing conditioning frames and tracking remaining frames
run_track_step: run a single tracking step fusing visual features with memory and running SAM segmentation heads
forward_SAM_heads: forward SAM prompt encoders and mask heads for segmentation given point or mask prompts
concat_points: concatenate new click points and labels to existing point inputs for interactive segmentation
